hero.subtitle: I help founders and product teams shape clear, usable products — from early definition to improving existing systems.

entryPoints.subtitle: Different stages, same goal: clarity before complexity.
entryPoints.title: There are three key moments when I typically

before.label: Before anything
before.heading: Consult before you commit
before.body: You have an idea or a problem, but you’re not sure what kind of help you actually need. Before jumping into design or development, it helps to talk it through.

early.label: Early stage
early.heading: Define before you design
early.body: You’re early, but serious. The goal is to make the product clear enough that development can move fast without chaos.

live.label: Live or in build
live.heading: Improve an active product
live.body: Your product or MVP is live, or actively being built. Things work, but the UX starts to feel fragile.

strategyPartnership.title: When UX isn’t the first step
strategyPartnership.subtitle: This is only relevant when the product direction isn’t clear yet.
strategyPartnership.intro: Sometimes the challenge isn’t the interface yet. In early or complex situations, teams need clarity around the problem, direction, or business logic before jumping into design.
strategyPartnership.partnershipBody: In these cases, I collaborate with a trusted strategic partner to help define what to build and why. We sharpen your product identity and decision-making framework to ensure the foundation is solid.
strategyPartnership.note: This is optional and only relevant when the product direction isn’t clear yet.

mvpExecution.title: From idea to working MVP
mvpExecution.subtitle: Relevant when teams need something real and usable, not just direction.
mvpExecution.intro: Sometimes teams don’t just need direction; they need something real, fast. When it’s the right fit, I help define the MVP scope, design the UX, and work closely with a trusted developer to turn the concept into a working product.

mvpExecution.boundaryText: I don’t run development teams. I lead the product thinking and UX, collaborating with development to move fast and smart without running a heavy development team.

about.title: About
about.body1:
I’ve spent over 10 years designing digital products — mostly with early-stage startups, where things move fast and the stakes are real.

Two years ago I moved from Tel Aviv to Berlin. Alongside client work, I’m building Reloways — a platform for people who relocate. It keeps me honest about what it actually takes to ship something, not just design it.

shape.title: Shape the product
shape.body: Structure, flows, and design before a single line of code. For teams that need clarity on what to build — and why — before development moves.

fix.title: Fix what’s fragile
fix.body: A clear look at what’s breaking trust in your existing product. Friction, inconsistency, and missed opportunities — with specific recommendations, not a report you’ll ignore.

scale.title: Build for scale
scale.body: The component foundation your team won’t fight against. Token architecture, component libraries, and documentation that actually gets used.

ai.title: Add intelligence
ai.body: Scoping and designing AI features that users actually notice. Not AI for the sake of it — AI where it genuinely changes the experience.

finalCta.heading: Have a product that needs clarity?
finalCta.body: I work with founders and product teams on what to build, how to structure it, and where the UX is costing them trust.

response.label: Response time
response.rest: Fast and focused feedback within 24 hours.

access.label: Direct access
access.rest: You work with me. Not a team you’ve never met.

feedback.title: Send your product. Get clarity back.
feedback.intro: Share a link or screenshots. Within 48 hours I'll reply with 3–4 focused UX observations — what's confusing users, what's breaking trust, and what to fix first.
feedback.trustLine: No commitment. If there's a fit, we'll both know.

perspective.body: Fresh eyes on your product — the kind your team can't give because you're too close to it.
